name: South Gate Pass
summary: South Gate Pass carries travelers between Dun Morogh and Loch Modan. Its guarded road links Ironforge with Thelsamar.

sections.title: The Road East
sections.body: South Gate Pass cuts through the Khaz Modan range, joining the high mountains of Dun Morogh to Loch Modan's valley in the east. Stone archways mark the way from the cold slopes into the warmer dwarven heartlands. The road leads toward Thelsamar, carrying mountaineers, couriers, and newly trained adventurers setting out from the capital.

sections.title: A Guarded Threshold
sections.body: Dwarven mountaineers keep watch at South Gate Outpost, guarding the pass against wild beasts and prowling troggs. The road is safer than the untamed parts of the valley, but hostile wildlife and roving threats still test its approaches. Travelers are advised to stay on the road.

faq.q: Where does South Gate Pass lead?
aliases: where does south gate pass go
faq.answer: Take the road west through the tunnels to reach Dun Morogh's snowy highlands and continue toward Ironforge. Eastward, the pass descends into Loch Modan's basin and leads toward Thelsamar.

faq.q: Is South Gate Pass safe to travel?
faq.answer: Dwarven guards at South Gate Outpost make the road relatively secure. Bears, spiders, and troggs still inhabit the crags and hillsides around the tunnel mouth.

faq.q: Why is this pass used more than North Gate Pass?
faq.answer: South Gate Pass offers the most direct and convenient overland route between Dun Morogh and Thelsamar. Local trade, supply caravans, and travelers bound for central Loch Modan favor it for that reason.

angles.text: For a dwarf leaving Dun Morogh, South Gate Pass marks the change from icy mountain air to the open valleys and quarries of Loch Modan.
For the Alliance, South Gate Pass links Ironforge with the eastern Alliance territories. The King's Mountaineers maintain and secure the route.
